steps.step15: Tuntuɓi sabis na komawa na gida

steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step24: Yi tantance amfani da miyagun ƙwayoyi

phase3.mentorshipHelp: Nemo mai jagoranci ko zama mai jagoranci.
phase3.geoHelp: Wasu suna ganin birninka kaɗai. Ba a taɓa raba ainihin wuri ba.
phase3.rideHelp: Nemi mota. Ba a taɓa nuna lambobin waya ba. Ku haɗu a wurin jama'a.
phase3.partnersHelp: Ƙananan ƙungiyoyi na uku-uku da ke kula da juna.
phase3.caption: Bayani kan hoto

phase3.qaHelp: Yi tambaya ba tare da suna ba. Mambobi na gaba su na amsawa.
phase3.ask: Yi tambaya ba tare da suna ba
phase3.merchHelp: Alamomi masu lamba kaɗai. Babu abin da ke bayyana ma'anarsu a waje, babu kwanan wata a buga.
phase3.shareHelp: Kati ɗaya da lambobin ci gabanka.
phase3.archiveHelp: Rufe saƙo don kanka. Ana buɗewa ranar tarihi.
phase3.matchHelp: Wakilin ka yana magana da wasu wakilai da farko. Soyayya a kashe take yanzu. Za ka iya ganin dalili, neman gabatarwa da sake gwadawa.
phase3.datingOff: An kashe soyayya har sai an sa ƙa'idar kwanaki.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Duba nan da farko. Na zaɓi, matakin birni kaɗai: duba wa zai je taronsa kuma ku haɗu ta saƙonnin app. Babu waya, babu ainihin wuri.
phase3.groupsHelp: Ƙungiyoyin murmurewa, taimakon komawa, addini da al'umma bisa birni da lokacin taro. Bayanan misali kaɗai — ba ainihin jerin ba.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Ana nunawa kaɗai idan babu kowa a allo da zai je taronsa. Yana buga buƙata mai tsari a app — matakin birni kaɗai, babu waya.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Babu motar tare da wannan taro, don haka ana nuna Ina bukatar mota a matsayin madadin.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Direbobin da aka amince kaɗai. Ana aika saƙonni ɗaya-bayan-ɗaya tare da jira na minti 2; ka tabbatar kafin na gaba.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.goalSaved: Abin da aka tara kawo yanzu ($)
phase3.musicHelp: Waƙoƙin misali kaɗai. Babu asusun yawo. Ana kashe mai kunnawa a cikin darussan akademi.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: An kashe kiɗa yayin da kake cikin darasi.
phase3.visLink: Mahada (ba a tsammani, ana iya janyewa)
phase3.shareWho: Yanzu: kai kaɗai. Yin mahada yana barin duk wanda ke da mahadar ya karanta.
phase3.suggestHelp: Shawarwari kaɗai — ba a buga komai ba sai ka ƙara.
